name: BioMysteryBench
intro: BioMysteryBench旨在评估AI科学家在组学数据驱动的生物发现方面的能力。该基准测试要求模型处理未经处理的原始数据，并回答诸如“哪个基因被敲除了”或“样本感染了什么病毒”等难题，从而评估其解决复杂分析挑战的能力。
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the Anthropic PDF system-card section on BioMysteryBench and short-horizon computational biology tasks: models receive unprocessed omics datasets, must combine computational analysis with biological reasoning, use bioinformatics and database tools where needed, answer mystery questions such as identifying a knocked-out gene or virus infection, compare answers to hidden biological ground truth, and report task accuracy; the source describes the benchmark as beneficial computational biology and reports Claude Opus 4.6 at 61.5%.
intro_en: BioMysteryBench aims to evaluate AI scientists' ability in omics data-driven biological discovery. This benchmark requires models to process raw, unprocessed data and answer challenging questions such as "Which gene was knocked out?" or "What virus infected the sample?" to assess their capability in tackling complex analytical challenges.
